Maîtriser 10 compétences. L'arbre Essaim: Master 10 skills. The Swarm tree opens.
En 508 av. J.-C., Clisthène confie le co: In 508 BC, Cleisthenes entrusted the council of Athens to 500 citizens chosen by lot, 50 per tribe. He did not call it democracy, but isonomia: equality before the law.
Maîtriser toutes les compétences d'Essai: Master every Swarm skill up to rank 2. A queen, but one who commands nothing.
Avant l'essaimage, les ouvrières cessent: Before swarming, the workers stop feeding the old queen: she stops laying and slims down, because a laying queen is too heavy to fly far.
Réussir 3 quiz parfaits dans Essaim. Pou: Pass 3 perfect quizzes in Swarm. For once, the crowd was you.
En 1906, à une foire de Plymouth, 800 pe: In 1906, at a fair in Plymouth, 800 people estimated the weight of an ox. The median estimate, 1,207 pounds, fell within 1% of the true weight, 1,198 pounds. Galton published it in Nature in 1907.
Maîtriser la ruche et l'essaim. Vous voi: Master the hive and the swarm. You are now as gifted as a worker bee, only less useful.
Un siècle avant von Frisch, l'apiculteur: A century before von Frisch, the beekeeper Nicholas Unhoch had already described bees dancing. He frankly admitted he did not know what the dance was for.
Maîtriser le tirage au sort athénien. Bo: Master Athenian selection by lot. Good news: you will never be chosen by lot to run anything.
Le plus grand fragment de kleroterion re: The largest kleroterion fragment found in the Athenian agora probably had nearly 1,000 slots. It was used to select citizens by lot by the hundreds.
Maîtriser le vote des tessons. Vous save: Master the potsherd vote. You now know that people cheated in elections before the ballot box was even invented.
Dans un puits près de l'Acropole, on a t: In a well near the Acropolis, 190 ostraka bearing the name of Themistocles were found. Handwriting analysis shows they were scratched by only fourteen people: ready-made ballots to hand out, or to sell.
Maîtriser les grands conseils. Il ne vou: Master the great councils. It only took you nine rounds of drawing lots to get there.
À Venise, le doge élu devait réunir au m: In Venice, the elected doge needed at least 25 votes out of 41. Before reaching those 41 electors, there were five drawings of lots and four elections.
Maîtriser Cardano et le hasard. Vos chan: Master Cardano and chance. Your odds of remembering everything are still to be calculated.
Cardano a énoncé, sans la démontrer, l'i: Cardano stated, without proving it, the idea that statistics become more reliable as the number of trials grows. It would take Jacob Bernoulli more than twenty years of effort to prove it.
Maîtriser la loi des grands nombres. Sur: Master the law of large numbers. Over a large number of trials, even you end up getting it right.
Jacques Bernoulli voulait une spirale lo: Jacob Bernoulli wanted a logarithmic spiral on his tomb, with the motto "Eadem mutata resurgo". The engraver carved an Archimedean spiral, which has nothing to do with it.
Maîtriser le prix de la longitude. Vous: Master the longitude prize. You know where you are. That's something.
En 1772, le roi George III teste lui-mêm: In 1772, King George III personally tested one of John Harrison's watches for ten weeks: it varied by only a third of a second a day. The king then urged Harrison to claim his due from Parliament.
Maîtriser le savoir à plusieurs mains. J: Master knowledge by many hands. Jaucourt wrote 17,266 articles; you read one card.
Arrêté en juillet 1749, Diderot passe pl: Arrested in July 1749, Diderot spent several months in solitary confinement in the keep of Vincennes. Released on 3 November, he resumed the Encyclopédie, whose first volume came out two years later.
Maîtriser le paradoxe du vote. Vous voil: Master the voting paradox. You can no longer trust an election. Welcome.
Le nom de Jean-Charles de Borda est l'un: Jean-Charles de Borda's name is one of the 72 names of scientists engraved on the Eiffel Tower. A crater on the Moon also bears his name.
Maîtriser la main invisible. Vous savez: Master the invisible hand. Now you know where your credits go: into a very visible hand, mine.
Adam Smith était célèbre pour sa distrac: Adam Smith was famous for his absent-mindedness: he is said to have fallen into a tanning pit while discussing free trade, and to have brewed buttered bread in a teapot.
Maîtriser les sociogrammes. Dans le rése: Master sociograms. In your friends' network, you are a dot. An isolated one.
Les co-auteurs d'un chercheur ont en moy: A researcher's co-authors have on average more publications and citations than they do, and our followers have on average more followers than we do: the friendship paradox is everywhere.
Maîtriser la question du chef. Rassurez-: Master the question of the leader. Don't worry, I'm staying in the room.
Dans une expérience de Lewin, Lippitt et: In an experiment by Lewin, Lippitt and White, boys from an autocratically led group tried to destroy what they had made. The democratic groups, on the other hand, displayed their work or took it home.
Maîtriser les camps et l'identité. Chois: Master camps and identity. Choose your side: mine, obviously.
En 1935, Muzafer Sherif montre qu'un poi: In 1935, Muzafer Sherif showed that a motionless point of light, which seems to move in the dark, is enough to create a norm: in a group, estimates converge, and each person keeps the group's estimate a week later.
Maîtriser la stigmergie. Une fourmi trou: Master stigmergy. An ant finds the shortest path without thinking. You think.
Les algorithmes de colonies de fourmis d: Ant colony algorithms lay down "virtual pheromones" on promising paths. The first, Marco Dorigo's ant system, dates from 1991.
Maîtriser l'art d'interroger les experts: Master the art of questioning experts. I predict you will forget everything. I am an expert.
En 1900, John Elfreth Watkins annonçait: In 1900, John Elfreth Watkins announced for the year 2000 the disappearance of the letters C, X and Q, and that photographs would be telegraphed from any distance. He was wrong about the letters, right about the photos.
Master small worlds and weak ties. You are six handshakes away from anyone. Yet nobody calls you back.
Dans un des essais de Milgram, 232 des 2: In one of Milgram's trials, 232 of the 296 letters sent never arrived. The "six degrees" only hold for the chains that got through.
Maîtriser la coopération. Je vous propos: Master cooperation. I offer you a deal: you revise, I stay nice. Let's see.
Elinor Ostrom refusait l'idée que la tra: Elinor Ostrom rejected the idea that the tragedy of the commons was inevitable: when users cooperate, monitor each other and enforce their rules, the shared resource can last.
Master the art of forecasting together. I forecast at 80% that you will forget half. I leave 20% to miracles.
Edward Lorenz a fait tourner ses simulat: Edward Lorenz ran his 1961 simulations on a Royal McBee LGP-30 computer. His founding paper, "Deterministic Nonperiodic Flow", came out in 1963.
Maîtriser l'intelligence du web. Avec as: Master the intelligence of the web. Given enough eyes, all bugs show. I've got my eye on you.
Foldit, jeu de pliage de protéines lancé: Foldit, a protein-folding game launched in 2008 by the University of Washington, has about 240,000 registered players. In 2010, the journal Nature credited 57,000 players as co-authors of results that matched or beat the algorithms.
Maîtriser l'intelligence d'un groupe. Vo: Master the intelligence of a group. Your c factor is excellent. C as in "clueless", but excellent.
Douglas Engelbart prédisait dès 1962 un: Douglas Engelbart predicted as early as 1962 a multiplier effect in group problem-solving. In 1994 he would coin the term "collective IQ".
Aristote serait le premier à l'avoir écr: Aristotle is credited as the first to write it, in the Politics: it is possible that the many, though not individually good men, may be better when they come together. In 1785 Condorcet turned it into a theorem about juries, the oldest and simplest of its kind.
